capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Battery total 100.5 kWh (R/T and Scat Pack). Same pack carried 2025-2027 (no change documented). The cited sheet is titled PRELIMINARY SPECIFICATIONS (2024) and has not been checked against a final sheet.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Usable energy 93.9 kWh on the 2024 spec sheet; later years carry the same pack.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Stellantis states nickel manganese cobalt for the 400 V, 100.5 kWh, 131 Ah-cell pack in the Wagoneer S and Recon spec sheets; the Charger spec sheet gives the same kWh and 400 V but no chemistry. Motor1 calls the Charger chemistry nickel-cobalt-aluminium (conflict).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Peak battery voltage 442 V; Stellantis calls the architecture 400 V (Mopar 2026 handbook: DC fast charge (400 V)).

dc_max_kw.notes: Peak charge rate with a 350 kW (500 A) EVSE 183 kW (InsideEVs and Motor1 agree). Conflict: Wagoneer S (same 100.5 kWh pack) is "rated at 203 kW" (InsideEVs) and Jeep gives 20-80 % in 23 min vs 27.6 min for 5-80 % here, so the two vehicles may not share charging hardware.

ac_max_kw.notes: On-board charger L2 AC max charge rate 11 kW.
